scope: Exact scalar polynomial identities and complete Bernstein coefficients for C032/C033/C037/C038/C071, the adopted Q117 payment and pointwise rows, the two reference-curvature templates, and the adopted ordinary unit-minimum triple/outer-path reductions. The adopted R43 finite-packet, positive-square and coupled-mask scalar comparisons are included. The three original R26 compatible-square Hermite gaps are preserved; two whole-domain retained-pair payments replace the older high-only IV, and their complete frequency-norm polynomial is also included. The complete Q50/Q89 unit-root ordinary-eighth families include five full-interval compatible-moment payments, thirty interpolation guards and thirteen signed-moment payments. The adopted common unit-root transport and its actual parameter modes are additionally source-bound; their analytic deductions are not formally verified by this scalar program. The whole shortest-two family retains its four actual endpoint polynomials and18 coefficients; the new finite positive-square packet is additionally source-bound, not formally verified here. The complete Family B root-mask proof includes ten continuous frequency gaps and33 coefficients; the signed fourth/eighth reductions and real C084/C113/C186 consumers remain analytic proof arguments. The adopted retained-reference proof includes five complete Taylor payments with149 coefficients, three curvature differences and two actual log-convexity numerators with29 further coefficients. The retained finite packet is source-bound; its signed original-measure derivation and the true two-loss L3 repair remain analytic proof arguments. The complete remaining R40 ordinary family adds seven actual joint/coupled-mean frequency gaps and42 coefficients, rebuilt with their positive denominator and removable endpoint normalizations. The all-finite q-row, four receiver modes, strong fourth resources and actual two-T inverse-q consumer remain analytic proof arguments. The complete unit-p ordinary fourth/eighth family adds six complete continuous payments and74 coefficients from the actual scalar definitions. Its signed finite ledgers, short exceptions, whole-vector comparisons, all-integer-length arguments and actual directions remain textual analytic proofs. Certificate records count closed cells, not independent theorems. Analytic message, covariance, finite-length and domain reductions are stated in the manuscript and independently cross-read; this program does not formally verify them or the full paper.
arithmetic: fractions.Fraction; restricted arithmetic parser; no floating point, network, eval, exec or external algebra library
